cim_eredeti: European Workers’ AI Use on Par With That of US Peers, ECB Says
szoveg_eredeti:
Euro-area workers are turning to artificial intelligence at a similar rate as their peers in the US, though obstacles remain to reaping more of the technology’s benefits, according to European Central Bank research.

More than two-fifths of employees in the currency bloc reported using AI at least weekly in August, comparable to numbers across the Atlantic, the ECB said Friday in a blog post citing data from its monthly Consumer Expectations Survey. A larger share in Europe, 18%, even said they rely on it on a daily basis.
